A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we introduce a hash accumulator for the Bitcoin UXTO set, and we show that the proofs for the UTXO are small enough to not be a bottleneck for the network.
the Utreexo accumulator can be used as a replacement for the UTXO database, and can be used to reduce the storage and network bandwidth required for a validating node.
Utreexo can reduce storage requirements of Bitcoin nodes by a factor of 20-30x, and network traffic by 5-10x.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the UTXO accumulator can significantly reduce memory requirements of Bitcoin nodes.
the UTXO state can be represented as an accumulator, which can be used to validate transactions.
